title: We Are Getting Married — Wedding Planner
descriptionHtml:
Organise the celebrations with We Are Getting Married — Wedding Planner, a guided wedding planner for outfits, events, appointments, budgets and important details.

What’s Inside

We have got you covered on:
•Basic planning aka wedding goals sheets, where you plan a rough sketch of what you want.
•Trousseau shopping and packaging - consists of basic Trousseau checklist where you can also make additions. There is also a categorically Trousseau planning section where you can write list of things you need.
•Grooming and salon appointments- to plan and schedule your salon appointments.
•Self care schedule where you can set aside some days for yourself. 
•Bridesmaid and bachelorette party planning: invite, duties , defining their clothes, destination for bachelorette, theme, etc.
• A letter from the groom and things you can look back when things get difficult.
• Prewedding, save the date and wedding invite sheets for planning the pre-wedding tam jham.
•Main Attires: outfit- makeup - accessory - groom outfit (Because, of course!)
In this you can plan attire’s for 6 ceremonies i.e wedding + 5 other main functions where you need to plan the in depth detailing of the attire. There is a rough ideating and the “this is it” page.
•Plan of action (ceremony wise): there is wedding + 5 main functions’ in-depth function planning where you can plan the decor- menu- venue- guest list.
